title: Detecting RAG Extraction Attack via Dual-Path Runtime Integrity Game
authors: Yuanbo Xie; Yingjie Zhang; Yulin Li; Shouyou Song; Xiaokun Chen; Zhihan Liu; Liya Su; Tingwen Liu
